paragraphs: In the morning, follow up with owners to renew listings and assess their minimum price and attitude. At midday, show properties and explain layouts, commutes, and school districts. Before signing, verify loan-to-value ratios and taxes and revise several versions of the plan. In the afternoon, follow the process and expedite appraisals and transfers. Before leaving, organize the client list and prepare for concentrated weekend showings.

In one line: turn a property into a completed sale.
